tools.name: list_diagram_types
tools.description: List supported diagram types and formats. Optional filters: query, backend, output_format, limit.

tools.name: generate_uml
tools.description: Render one diagram. Returns url, playground, and chat markdown. Use output_format=png for inline bytes, or call generate_uml_image.

diagram_type.description: Diagram type such as class, sequence, mermaid, d2, or graphviz. Use list_diagram_types when unsure.

code.description: Diagram source code in the syntax required by diagram_type.

output_dir.description: Local directory to save the rendered file. Omit for URL/base64 output. Hosted/read-only deployments reject file output.

output_format.description: Requested output format: svg, png, pdf, jpeg, txt, or base64 when supported by the selected diagram type.

theme.description: Optional theme: PlantUML name (e.g. cerulean), Mermaid default/dark/forest/neutral/base, or D2 default/dark (theme-id); ignored for other backends.

scale.description: SVG scale factor. For example, 2.0 doubles SVG dimensions. Ignored for non-SVG output.

tools.name: generate_uml_image
tools.description: INLINE IMAGE: render a diagram as MCP ImageContent (PNG default) for chat. Use when the user asks to show or display the diagram. Fetches bytes even under URL-only.

tools.name: validate_uml
tools.description: Validate diagram type, format, and syntax locally (no render). Set strict=true for extra Mermaid/D2 checks.

diagram_type.description: Diagram type to validate. Use list_diagram_types when unsure.

code.description: Diagram source code to validate locally without rendering.

output_format.description: Output format whose compatibility should be validated.

tools.name: generate_uml_batch
tools.description: Render several diagrams with bounded concurrency. Each item uses the same fields as generate_uml. Partial failures stay isolated per index.

resources.name: uml://types
resources.description: Returns available diagram types with backend, description, and supported formats (e.g. class, sequence, mermaid, d2). Use before generating to verify diagram_type.

resources.name: uml://templates
resources.description: Returns starter templates (PlantUML, Mermaid, D2, etc.) for each diagram type. Use to get minimal valid code to customize.

resources.name: uml://examples
resources.description: Returns example diagrams for each type (class, sequence, activity, etc.). Use as reference for syntax and structure.

resources.name: uml://formats
resources.description: Returns supported output formats (svg, png, pdf) per diagram type. Use to choose valid output_format for generate_uml.

resources.name: uml://capabilities
resources.description: Matrix of diagram_type -> backend engine and supported output_format values. Same data the server uses for validation before render.

resources.name: uml://server-info
resources.description: Returns server metadata: name, version, tools, prompts, Kroki URL. Use for discovery and health checks.

resources.name: uml://recipes
resources.description: Starter recipes (algorithm_flowchart, paper_concept) with diagram_type + template for generate_uml.

resources.name: uml://workflow
resources.description: Plan-then-generate workflow; pairs with uml_diagram / skill://uml-mcp-diagrams/SKILL.md.

prompts.name: uml_diagram
prompts.description: Plan-then-generate any catalog diagram_type. context: diagram_type?, thinking=false?

prompts.name: algorithm_explainer
prompts.description: Algorithm diagram with Big-O labels; uml://recipes algorithm_flowchart.

prompts.name: paper_concept_diagram
prompts.description: Paper/concept diagram with clickable citations (SVG); uml://recipes paper_concept.

prompts.name: diagram_theme
prompts.description: Pick a generate_uml theme for light, dark/black, or B&W backgrounds. context: background?, diagram_type?

prompts.name: architecture_report
prompts.description: Markdown architecture report with generate_uml diagrams and TOC.
